title: DRAG: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:PARK LIGHTS (10,859 affected)
summary: REAR LIGHTS DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE PHOTOMETRIC REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT". THE TAILLIGHTS MAY NOT PROVIDE ADEQUATE ILLUMINATION FOR SAFE OPERATION WHEN BRAKING OR WHEN OPERATING AT NIGHT.

title: Jayco, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:CAMPER:SLIDE-IN (9/82) (90 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES DO NOT MEET FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 126, "TRUCK-CAMPER LOADING". CERTIFICATION LABELS DO NOT PROVIDE TRUCK CAMPER LOADING INFORMATION.

title: DUNLOP TIRE CORPORATION: TIRES:LINER (39,462 affected)
summary: A SMALL PERCENTAGE OF THE PRODUCTION IN THIS SIZE AND TYPE MAY HAVE A MISPLACED PLY ENDING IN THE LOWER SIDEWALL. AS A RESULT, FLEXING WILL DEVELOP IN THE LOWER SIDEWALL UNDER SUSTAINED HIGH TIRE LOAD AND COULD RESULT IN TREAD SEPARATION AND COMPONENT BREAKUP.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:TAIL LIGHTS (72,754 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN OF THE INVOLVED VEHICLES, THE LAMP BULB SOCKET BARRELS ARE INSUFFICIENTLY PRESSED INTO THE PLASTIC OUTER SHEELS. THIS CAUSES AN OPEN OR GROUNDED CIRCUIT AND A MALFUNCTION.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:METALLIC (1,236 affected)
summary: ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES, IMPROPER ROUTING OF THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE TUBE COULD CAUSE IT TO CHAFE AGAINST THE PARK BRAKE CABLES. EVENTUALLY, THE BRAKE TUBE MAY FAIL AND BRAKE FLUID LEAKAGE MAY OCCUR.

title: ZIMMER MOTOR CARS CORP.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (31 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES DO NOT CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 208, "OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION IN PASSENGER CARS, MPVS, TRUCKS AND BUSES". THE NON-COMPLIANCE EXISTS BECAUSE THE SEAT BELTS MAY HAVE BEEN OMITTED FROM THE LOUNGE AND JUMP SEATS.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:RIGID (149 affected)
summary: UNDER CERTAIN TOLERANCE CONDITIONS, THE ACCELERATOR ROD MAY COME INTO CONTACT WITH THE ACCELERATOR RETURN SPRING BRACKET, CREATING THE POSSIBILITY OF A MOMENTARY DELAY IN THE RETURN OF THE ACCELERATOR LINKAGE TO THE IDLE POSITION. THIS CONDITION IS MORE LIKELY TO OCCUR AT 3/4 THROTTLE BECAUSE CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE ACCELERATOR ROD AND BRACKET IS AT A MINIMUM AT THIS POINT.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK (2,800 affected)
summary: DURING A CRASH BARRIER TEST, THE RUBBER HOSE CONNECTING THE FUEL TANK AND THE METAL FILLER PIPE VENT TUBE WAS CUT, RESULTING IN FUEL LEAKAGE. THE INVOLVED VEHICLES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 301, "FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY".

title: HOLLAND HITCH COMPANY: STRUCTURE:FIFTH WHEEL ASSEMBLY (350,880 affected)
summary: ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES, THERE IS A POSSIBILITY OF A FATIGUE CRACK STARTING AT THE PLUNGER WINDOW OF THE OUTBOARD SUPPORT LEG OF THE BRACKET SUB ASSEMBLIES.

title: Caterpillar, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL TANK:AUXILLARY (272 affected)
summary: A POSSIBILITY EXISTS ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES, THAT DUE TO VIBRATIONS GENERATED BY THE TRUCK, THE FUEL FILTER"S TOP CONNECTOR MAY BREAK FROM THE BOTTOM OF THE FUEL TANK DUE TO METAL FATIGUE. THIS FAILURE ALLOWS THE DIESEL IGNITION IMPROVER TO SPRAY OUT FUEL.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM (172,863 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES DO NOT CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 210, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES". THE NON-COMPLIANCE EXISTS BECAUSE THE REAR SEAT BELT ANCHORAGES MAY PULL THROUGH THE UNDERBODY OF THE VEHICLE IF ENOUGH FORCE IS APPLIED.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (25 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN VEHICLES IMPROPER AIR HOSE ASSEMBLY PROCEDURES MAY HAVE RESULTED IN PIECES BEING LEFT IN THE HOSE. THESE PIECES COULD BLOCK THE HOSE AND CAUSE A MALFUNCTION.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): EQUIPMENT:DOOR:FUEL FILLER:ELECTRIC (5,234 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY BE EQUIPPED WITH AN ELECTRICAL FUEL FILLER DOOR RELEASE WHICH IS ACTIVATED THROUGH A COILED CURRENT CARRYING WIRE (A SOLENOID). A SHORT IN THE SOLENOID COULD CAUSE SPARKING AT THE ATTACHING SCREWS OF THE SOLENOID.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): EQUIPMENT:ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT:TRIP COMPUTER/MONITOR (479 affected)
summary: THE TRAVEL COMPUTER SYSTEM WIRING, ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES, MAY BE IMPROPERLY CONNECTED. THIS CONDITION CAN CAUSE DAMAGE TO INTERNAL COMPONENTS.

title: redundant PREVOST CAR, INC. Inactive: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN (669 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN VEHICLES THE STEERING WHEEL RETAINING NUT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN ADEQUATELY TIGHTENED DURING ASSEMBLY. THE NUT MAY CONTINUE TO LOOSEN AND COULD EVENTUALLY COME OUT, ALLOWING THE STEERING WHEEL TO SEPARATE FROM THE STEERING COLUMN.
